about: Which suites a changed path needs (R163). `cargo t` (testkit/src/plan.rs) and CI (scripts/ci-scope.mjs) both read this file. The first rule that matches a path wins; a path no rule matches needs every suite. A rule matches a path that is one of its `files`, starts with one of its `prefixes` or ends with one of its `suffixes`. docs/product-map.md needs the Rust suite because engine/tests/product_map.rs reads it.
